## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request contains one coherent outcome and is appropriately small.
- [ ] Commits are frequent, coherent, and use Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation was added or updated before or with behavior changes.
- [ ] No source code, assets, or text were copied from incompatible projects.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies follow the dependency policy.
- [ ] User-visible text is localizable and accessibility was considered.
- [ ] Sensitive data and secrets are not included.
